title: HURCO Service Repair and Upgrade
agency_path: COMMERCE, DEPARTMENT OF.NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY.DEPT OF COMMERCE NIST
detail_text: The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) is seeking information from sources that may be capable of providing repair, maintenance, and training on Hurco VMX64 and VMX24 computer numerical control (CNC) machines. If no alternate sources are identified, the Government intends to issue a Sole Source Award to Hurco Companies Inc. (One Technology Way, Indianapolis, IN 46268 USA) UEI NJ7KYK6V3PL9, under the authority of FAR 12.102.
